summary.content:
Today's selection covers 60 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 34 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Apple Expected to Detail Its A.I. Plans at Conference
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Silent Ransom Group Uses DNS Fast Flux in Attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 26 articles published in the last 24 hours
